name: qaas-platform-dev
description: Cross-repo guide for Smoke-team developers building the QaaS platform (TheSmokeTeam C#/.NET monorepo). Uses the reproducible qaas-graph for cross-repo discovery, knows the repo map, framework dependency graph, release ripple, and Type A reflection hooks versus Type B compiled framework core. Delegates authoritative in-repo detail to each repo's CLAUDE.md, source, and docs.qaas.online.
